title: Holy-Crap: poultry dropping detection on a QNX Raspberry Pi 5 (code, models, results and paper)
description: Code, trained models, per-photograph predictions, appearance grades, figures and the paper for: Held-out Accuracy Is Not New-Collection Accuracy: A Cross-Collection Benchmark of Poultry Dropping Classifiers and a Process-Isolated Pen-Camera Pipeline on a QNX Raspberry Pi 5. Every model trained on the same split of the Machuve et al. farm photographs scores 98.5 to 99.6% on the farm test and 75 to 78% on a separate PCR-labelled collection. The repository also contains a pen-scale detector fine-tuned on public barn video, a multi-process pipeline running on a Raspberry Pi 5 under QNX 8.0, a dashboard, a wrist display client and a farmer messaging agent. Third-party datasets are not included and must be downloaded from their own Zenodo records.
